name: 粉格子蝴蝶结毛绒口袋滑雪套装
nameEn: Pink Gingham Bow Ski Suit with Fluffy Pockets
description:
粉白格子印浅蓝色蝴蝶结的宽松外套，两个大毛绒口袋，配粉色工装雪裤，裤腿口袋也是同款格子。软萌甜美。尺码 S。

## 面料与科技
- 防水指数 15000mmH₂O，透湿指数 10000g/m²
- 3L 复合面料：外层 DWR 防水涂层 + 中层防水透气膜 + 柔软亲肤层
- 外层和内衬都是 100% 聚酯纤维，加绒内里

## 设计细节
- 宽松版型，加绒厚度
- 网纱防雪袖，透气又不占手套空间
- 腰部防雪裙、裤脚防雪裙，可松紧调节

## 尺码（S，适合身高 160–169cm）
- 上衣：衣长 77cm、胸围 131cm、肩宽 52.5cm、袖长 60cm
- 雪裤：裤长 104cm、腰围 72–82cm、臀围 137cm、腿围 87cm
descriptionEn:
A relaxed pink-and-white gingham jacket printed with pale blue bows, with two big fluffy pockets, paired with pink cargo snow pants trimmed in the same gingham. Soft and sweet. Size S.

## Fabric & Tech
- Waterproof rating 15,000 mmH₂O; breathability 10,000 g/m²
- 3L fabric: DWR-coated shell + waterproof breathable membrane + soft inner layer
- 100% polyester shell and lining, with a fleece-lined interior

## Design Details
- Relaxed fit, fleece-lined warmth
- Mesh snow cuffs that breathe and don't crowd your gloves
- Snow skirt at the waist and adjustable snow gaiters at the cuffs

## Size (S, fits 160–169 cm / 5'3"–5'7")
- Jacket: length 77 cm, chest 131 cm, shoulder 52.5 cm, sleeve 60 cm
- Pants: length 104 cm, waist 72–82 cm, hips 137 cm, leg 87 cm
